label: sk-create-changelog has one add candidate: CHG-007 makes the workflow ask for a component choice when path and hint evidence do not resolve one, and no turn scripts the answer, so a companion conversation that names the component and checks the write path would cover the answer-dependent half (Q2). The other twelve scenarios stay single prompt under Q4.

sk-create-command has no conversation candidate: its six scenarios inspect an authored command's component choice, path, input gate, mode targets and router ownership; the gate and confirm-mode behavior belong to the command being authored, not to an exchange in the create-command session, so Q2 does not apply and Q4 keeps them single prompt.

sk-create-diff has no conversation candidate: its eleven scenarios run create_diff.py comparison, snapshot or safety commands and read the report or exit status in one pass; the oh-I-never-saved-a-baseline wording is a prompt detail, not a second exchange, so Q4 keeps them single prompt.

sk-create-feature-catalog has no conversation candidate: its six scenarios are catalog structure, root-to-leaf parity, source-anchor, slug and validation checks, each one prompt plus a validator run; Q2 finds no second exchange and Q4 keeps them single prompt.

sk-create-frontmatter has no conversation candidate: its eleven scenarios resolve a document class, trim a description or derive a version, each from one prompt plus a check that would catch the silent failure; FMC-003's declined action is a refusal, not a question, so Q4 keeps them single prompt.
